plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art - Art History A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7892/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Total Units 60 = 15+15+15+15 (semester sums verified). List A (minimum 9 units): ARTH 312, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARCH 310, HUM 300, HUM 310, HUM 320, HUM 332 — one course sequenced per semester in Semesters 2-4; a different course should be taken for each List A slot. List B (minimum 3 units): satisfied by ART 300 in Semester 1 per map ('Counts as class from List B'). Elective slots: open electives with map recommendations (Sem 2: ARTH 325; Sem 3: ARTH 312; Sem 4: ARTH 328 or ARTH 333); units determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation.
